title: Overplus
summary: O'VERPLUS, noun [over and Latin plus, more.] Surplus; that which remains after a supply, or beyond a quantity proposed. Take what is wanted and return the overplus It would look like a fable to report

inlines.v: O'VERPLUS, noun [over and Latin plus, more.] Surplus; that which remains after a supply, or beyond a quantity proposed. Take what is wanted and return the overplus It would look like a fable to report that this gentleman gives away all which is the overplus of a great fortune.
